title: LLM-OSDA: An Optimal-Stopping Dynamic Auction for Native Advertising in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2608.00123v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM-native advertising embeds sponsored content directly into model-generated responses, shifting the unit of sale from a fixed slot to a moment within an evolving conversation. Existing LLM ad-auction mechanisms primarily operate within a single response, settling the winner but not the timing. The extension is nontrivial: with one native insertion opportunity per session, the stopping time depends on bids, coupling timing with allocation, so static truthfulness arguments no longer apply. We propose the LLM-based Optimal Stopping Dynamic Auction (LLM-OSDA), a dynamic cost-per-click auction that integrates Bellman optimal stopping, winner allocation, and envelope pricing. A bid-independent LLM layer estimates contextual click quality and seamlessly renders the winning ad, while bids enter only the committed auction mechanism. Under an exact Bellman oracle, the expected discounted-click allocation is monotone in each advertiser'

translated_title: LLM-OSDA：一种用于多轮LLM对话中原生广告的最优停时动态拍卖
translated_abstract: LLM原生广告将赞助内容直接嵌入模型生成的回复中，将销售单位从固定广告位转变为不断演进的对话中的某个时刻。现有的LLM广告拍卖机制主要在单次回复内运作，只确定获胜者而不确定投放时机。这一扩展并非易事：由于每个会话仅有一次原生广告插入机会，停时取决于出价，使时机与分配相互耦合，静态的真实性论证不再适用。我们提出基于LLM的最优停时动态拍卖（LLM-OSDA），这是一种动态按点击付费拍卖，集成了Bellman最优停时、获胜者分配和包络定价。一个与出价无关的LLM层估计情境化点击质量并无缝呈现获胜广告，而出价仅进入承诺的拍卖机制。在精确的Bellman oracle下，期望折扣点击分配在每个广告主的出价上是单调的。
tldr: 提出LLM-OSDA，一种融合Bellman最优停时理论的动态按点击付费拍卖机制，解决了多轮LLM对话中原生广告投放时机与获胜者分配相耦合的拍卖设计难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes LLM-OSDA, a dynamic cost-per-click auction integrating Bellman optimal stopping theory to address the coupled timing-allocation problem of native advertising in multi-turn LLM conversations.
